# Phase 2 baselines (generated by experiments/run_baselines.py)

1222 perturbations (1144 genes, 78 drugs), 22 symptoms, relation induces. Grouped split: 5-fold cross-validation with leakage groups by disease_cluster_and_targets (717 groups); out-of-fold predictions pooled. The 317 lockbox perturbations of configs/lockbox_v1.json were removed first. Unobserved pairs count as negatives (positive-unlabelled convention). Label selection data/processed/label_selection/better_v1_full_v2.parquet: 2228 of 4439 positive pairs set aside, neither positive nor negative in fitting or scoring (positive counts in the hold-out tables include them). Pooled metrics are computed on the pooled out-of-fold predictions; per-fold values are the mean and standard deviation over folds of the macro metric, which is immune to the base-rate artifact that pulls pooled AUROC of a constant-per-fold predictor below 0.5.

## Pathway-wise split, Human-GEM subsystems (every gene whose primary subsystem is the held-out one)

Subsystems are the reconstruction's own pathway partition; they cover many more annotated genes than the curated modules and are the candidate definition of the pre-registered pathway-wise split.
 Raw pooled scores across hold-outs with different base rates carry the artifact of section 6.2 (review v0.4, finding 1); the rank-within-hold-out columns replace each score by its tie-averaged rank over (n + 1) inside its hold-out before pooling, and the stratified AUROC forms positive-negative pairs inside hold-outs only. The pathway-wise endpoint is defined on the rank-within-hold-out macro AUPRC. Perturbations sharing a leakage group with a held-out one are left out of that hold-out's fit.

Held out (perturbations, scored positive pairs): Curated neurotransmission (32, 108); Inositol phosphate metabolism (11, 21); Lysine metabolism (13, 17); Nucleotide metabolism (21, 32); Oxidative phosphorylation (18, 34); Tricarboxylic acid cycle and glyoxylate/dicarboxylate metabolism (5, 12).
